Drug: Sumatriptan
Dosage and route: 50 or 100 mg oral or 6 mg subcutaneous or 10 or 20 mg intranasal
Contraindications: Cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease, uncontrolled hypertension, hemiplegic migraine, migraine with brainstem aura
It typically causes throbbing or pulsing pain, which is often on one side of your head.
